atoms.text: Aunt Matilda asked June to be careful not to break the vase. The vase had belonged to Matilda’s mother, so it was very important to Matilda. While playing in the house, June knocked the vase to the ground, and it shattered into lots of little pieces.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, will Matilda be upset that the vase broke?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Brad’s mum has told him to go and get a job at the local coffee shop. Brad doesn’t know anything about coffee, and he doesn’t want to work in a café. Brad is rude to the interviewer and doesn’t answer many of the questions.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, do you think that Brad will get the job?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Tabitha has worked for the bank for seven years. She enjoys her work and has spent the last year working towards a promotion. As she walks into the interview room, she feels confident. The interviewer thinks that Tabitha is perfect for the job.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, do you think Tabitha will get the promotion?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Jennifer loves blueberries. Yesterday, she bought herself some blueberries from the shop. She was excited to eat the blueberries and had planned to make meringue nests with them. Her sister, Polly, ate all of the blueberries while Jennifer was at work.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, do you think Jennifer will be happy that Polly ate the blueberries?
